 Around the NFL NFL Network: Cardinals to trade QB Jacoby Brissett to Ravens
 Published: Loading... Around the NFL Staff NFL.com Share Facebook Share Twitter The Baltimore Ravens are making a move to shore up their depleted quarterback room.
 The Ravens are finalizing a trade for Arizona Cardinals QB Jacoby Brissett , NFL Network Insider Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Adam Schefter reported on Wednesday.
 The trade is expected to be completed this weekend, Rapoport and Schefter reported. The Ravens face the Jacksonville Jaguars on Thursday with undrafted rookie QB Joe Fagnano set to start following injuries to Lamar Jackson (right thumb) and Tyler Huntley (toe).
 The Cardinals benched Brissett earlier this week in favor of  Gardner Minshew , who led Arizona to a comeback win over the Dallas Cowboys last Sunday, and rookie  Carson Beck was elevated to the QB2 role in the desert, which made Brissett a trade target.
 Around The NFL will have more on this news soon.
